strategy: Generated photographic fixed plate with deterministic authentic screen insertion; no 3D rendering in v6.

primary.clip_spec: 1536x1024, 24fps, 96 frames, 4 seconds, H264 SDR BT709 limited-range, square pixels, silent

provenance.plate_qualification: Generated approximate iPhone Pro style, not derived from the qualified v4 GLB, not exact Apple geometry. Model/seed/cost not reported by tool.
provenance.real_screen: Retained responsive frontend capture with fictional Meridian fixture data; not native-phone/backend proof.
provenance.simulated_os: source-profile.json: separate status/home regions around whole actual app capture; constant 9:41, Wi-Fi/signal/battery.
provenance.representative_source: source-screen.png, actual capture frame 84; pixel-identical to ../../v4/phone/default/imported-screen.png

calibration.method: Manual initial plane then robust straight-edge line fits to neutral gray component; conservative 1px mask inset excludes rounded corners, hardware and physical black pill/lens.
unknowns: Physical display dimensions and aspect are not calibrated; fitted approximately to generated plane.
Generated body is not identified with the imported v4 phone mesh.
calibration.checks: still-validation.json proves full app containment and no status glyph intersecting physical pill.

composition.antialias: 2x plate-space Lanczos4 warp, premultiplied alpha area resolve; exact original pixels restored outside binary active mask.
composition.source_clock: 96 sequential source frames at 24fps, no timing remap; simulated OS clock constant.
composition.determinism: Deterministic given pinned plate, source frames, config, mask and listed OpenCV/Numpy versions; image generation itself is not reproducible from seed.
composition.color: PNG source RGB; FFmpeg explicit full RGB to limited BT709 conversion and stream tags.
composition.identity: All pixels outside active screen remain exact before lossy encode, including hardware/pill/background.
composition.reproduction: Run prep_sources.py via PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 /usr/bin/python3 (system Pillow FreeType); calibrate.py and compose.py via /usr/bin/python3 with existing OpenCV. All encoding/decoding via ../../tools/run_owned.py, new output scope per run.

iterations.change: Single bounded 2x antialias refinement; no camera, geometry, source layout or generated plate changes.

limits.camera: Static; only real screen recording changes.
limits.small_text: Perspective reduces source pixel density; inspected encoded samples retained.
limits.resources: Owned CPU scopes: 2 CPU quota, 3G RAM, 128 tasks; declared timeouts and terminal receipts retained.
